# DEEPERNOVA AI STUDIO — EXHAUSTIVE PLATFORM SPECIFICATION
> Company: Deepernova AI Technologies
> Website: https://productionai-rho.vercel.app
> Region: Indonesia (Indonesian AI Research & Technologies)

## OVERVIEW
Deepernova AI is an advanced, fully autonomous Agentic AI Web Application and AI Document Studio Suite built for Microsoft Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Multi-LLM Chatbot Conversations, and Real-Time Web Research.

## CORE MODULES & ARCHITECTURE

### 1. TYPERNOVA AGENTIC DOCX STUDIO (DOCUMENT EDITOR)
- **Autonomous Drafting Engine**: Generates comprehensive formal papers, research articles, business reports, and academic essays chapter by chapter without requiring manual prompts for each section.
- **Automatic Dotted Table of Contents (DAFTAR ISI)**: Generates academic-standard Table of Contents with dotted leader lines (`................`) connecting headings to right-aligned page numbers. Dynamically updates from actual document headings (`h1`, `h2`, `h3`, `h4`).
- **Real-Time Canvas Context Reader**: AI Agent automatically pulls live HTML and text content from `pageRef.current` behind the scenes to perform surgical revisions without corrupting existing document content.
- **HD Chart & Curve Engine (2x DPI Resolution)**: Generates high-resolution PNG charts directly embedded into the canvas:
  - Pie Chart (market share & proportions)
  - Bar Chart (monthly comparisons)
  - Line Chart (time-series trends)
  - Area Chart (cumulative volume)
  - Scatter Plot (data distribution)
  - Gaussian Bell Curve & Sine Wave Mathematical Curves
- **Agentic Internet Image Citation & Placement**: Autonomously queries, fetches, and places relevant high-resolution web illustrations with italicized captions and credits. Features smart aesthetic alignment (`float-right`, `float-left` text wrapping, or `center`).
- **100% Microsoft Word (.docx) Compliance**: Exports documents with embedded PNG images (`ImageRun type: 'png'`), percentage table widths (`WidthType.PERCENTAGE`), formatted headings, and dotted Table of Contents paragraphs. Guaranteed 0 "unreadable content" errors in Microsoft Word.

### 2. DEEPERNOVA CHATBOT ASSISTANT
- **Multi-LLM Conversational Engine**: Context-aware conversational AI assistant supporting real-time RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), local file parsing (PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV), and code generation.
- **Automatic Chat-to-Document Conversion**: Automatically detects prompts requesting file creation or turning ongoing chat sessions into formal Word documents. Emits a 2-second interval transition card (0s -> 2s -> 4s) before seamlessly transitioning the user into Typernova Studio to write the file automatically.
- **Smart Canvas Protection**: Distinguishes between conversational chat queries and document creation instructions. Conversational responses remain in the chat bubble only, featuring a quick "📌 Sisipkan Ke Canvas Dokumen" button.

### 3. DEEPERNOVA UNIVERSE
- Interactive 3D/Visual AI Ecosystem node navigator for exploring Deepernova services, AI models, and workspace capabilities.

### 4. DEEPERNOVA EXCEL & PPTX ENGINE
- Multi-sheet spreadsheet generator with bold headers, custom borders, and formula calculations.
- Presentation slide generator supporting modern slide layouts and bullet structures.
